name: MiniMax
note: Quota only. MiniMax reports one window per model in a list rather than a keyed object, so the window key is the model name. The international endpoint is used; a China-region account should override `quota.endpoint` with api.minimaxi.com in ~/.antarium/harnesses/minimax.json. Model names come back verbatim, so badges/labels are declared for the models MiniMax ships today; an unlisted model still charts, abbreviated from its name. Set quota.credential to {"kind":"textFile","path":"~/.<name>-key"} or paste the key straight into this file. The environment variable works too, but only when Antarium is launched from a shell — an app started from Finder inherits no environment.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.

quota.setupHint: Add your API key to minimax.json.
